author: Alex
text: @mira We need a fictional knowledge tool for six people. Supplied options: Atlas costs 30/month for 6 seats and exports; Beacon costs 20/month for 6 seats without exports; Cedar costs 45/month for 10 seats with exports. Prefer low cost and easy exports. Recommend one and ask Quinn to check cost per used seat. Discuss only for now.

author: Mira
text:
Alex, I recommend Atlas at 30/month: it covers all six people and is the cheapest option with exports. Beacon saves 10/month but lacks exports; Cedar costs 15/month more for four seats we don’t need. Export ease isn’t specified.

@quinn Please check monthly cost per used seat for six people: Atlas 5, Beacon 3.33, and Cedar 7.50.

author: Quinn
text:
@mira All three calculations are correct, using six occupied seats:

| Option | Monthly cost | Cost per used seat | Exports |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Atlas | 30 | 5.00 | Yes |
| Beacon | 20 | 3.33 | No |
| Cedar | 45 | 7.50 | Yes |

Beacon is rounded to two decimals. Atlas is the lowest-cost option with exports; export ease remains unspecified.
